project_name: RevLoop — Multi-Tenant Garage SaaS + AI Sales Platform
app_type: saas_app / dashboard (mobile-first for garage owners) + public customer booking page

components_and_ui_patterns.navigation: Sticky top bar with glassmorphic backdrop (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0B0F17]/80 border-b border-white/10). Mobile bottom navigation bar for quick garage actions (Bay Calendar, Inbox, Quick Add, CRM).
components_and_ui_patterns.cards: Subtle border (border-white/10) with dark slate background (#1A2333), hover lift (-translate-y-0.5), crisp high contrast text.
components_and_ui_patterns.buttons: Primary: Amber/Orange gradient with solid tracking (bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-md transition-colors). Secondary: Glass dark button with subtle white border.
components_and_ui_patterns.tables: Dense, crisp data rows with alternating opacity, hover highlight, status badges with subtle tint.
components_and_ui_patterns.forms_and_inputs: Use Custom Shadcn inputs with dark backgrounds (bg-[#0F172A] border-slate-700 focus:border-orange-500 text-white).
components_and_ui_patterns.toasts: Sonner toast notifications imported from /src/components/ui/sonner.js or /src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
components_and_ui_patterns.testing_attribute: CRITICAL: Every interactive component (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dialog triggers, status badges, metrics) MUST contain data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='quick-add-customer-btn', data-testid='bay-calendar-slot').

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use JS/JSX syntax for code files as the repository uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx).
Ensure all key buttons, inputs, links, forms, and tabs include data-testid attributes.
Avoid generic pure black #000000 backgrounds; use deep navy slate (#0B0F17) with layered cards (#131B2A / #1A2333).
Implement mobile-first design as garage owners use phones in the garage bays.
Ensure CASL-compliant SMS consent checkboxes are explicit and unbundled on public booking pages.
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for visual indicators like Calendar, MessageSquare, Wrench, Car, PhoneCall, ShieldCheck, DollarSign.
Use sonner for notifications and toasts.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Maintain APCA AA standard contrast on dark slate backgrounds. Never put low-contrast grey text over dark background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous padding inside cards (p-4 to p-6), clean gaps between bento cells (gap-4 to gap-6).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactivity: Micro-animations on hover and active states (transition-all duration-200 hover:border-orange-500/50).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Full keyboard focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:outline-none) and aria attributes.
